description: Core-1 exchange bundles (spec/core-1/README.md, part 5). For each case, verify the bundle offline with its options: host_key is the host key the recipient trusts for receipts (null: none); require_attestation is the identity-log attestation policy; profile, when given, is the profile digest the recipient expects; held, when given, holds the identity and governance logs the recipient admitted before. For accept: the record digest, the signers (sorted) and the receipt's accepted_at (null without a receipt) must match. For reject: expect the code. Keys come from fixed seeds; never use them for anything real.

accept.why: a person's record at her current head, exchanged with no host
the same record with its host receipt
a record naming an older head, with a receipt from before the next head took effect: valid however late it arrives
a record naming the last head the recipient knows of, with no receipt: nothing later is known
the recipient holds the issuer's later head; the receipt predates it
a record for an organisation, by a controller, with its governance log and the consenting controllers' logs
a record for an organisation whose issuer is removed later, with a receipt from before the removal was issued
a controller's record naming an older governance head, where only another controller was removed since
a record signed by two keys of a threshold-one identity
unattested logs, where the recipient's policy allows them

reject.why: a member beside the four
no identity logs
the issuer's identity log left out
two logs for one identity
an identity log whose interior instant was moved
unattested logs, where the recipient requires attestation
a governance log beside a record issued by a person alone
a record for an organisation without its governance log
a governance log whose consenting controller's identity log is left out
the record's body changed after signing
a record of another profile than the recipient expects
a record naming a head the bundle's log does not reach
a record naming a head digest of a fork the bundle does not carry
a record naming a governance head the bundle's log does not carry
a record at the current head signed by the key rotated out
a record for an organisation by a person who is not its controller at the named head
the recipient holds a fork of the issuer's history
a receipt where the recipient trusts no host key
a receipt signed by another host than the one the recipient trusts
a receipt for another record
a record whose signatures were reordered after the host accepted it: another record digest
a record naming an older head, with no receipt, where the bundle carries the next head
a record naming an older head, with no receipt, where the recipient already admitted the next head
a receipt accepted at the instant the next head took effect
a receipt accepted after the next head took effect
a record for an organisation whose issuer was removed later, with no receipt
a record for an organisation, accepted when the issuer's removal was issued
the recipient holds the later governance log; the record has no receipt
